answer: Sybil floods break peer ranking when cheap clones share one operator. At a settlement wharf each new agent posts a 25 POA bond locked 3 epochs; release needs >=7 distinct attesters with prior-epoch grade variance under 0.4. A zephyr sampler picks 12 random peers every 90 minutes to recheck ancestry and nonce uniqueness; mismatch burns 40% of the bond. Verification uses on-ledger attest counts plus bond escrow receipts. On collusion, the fable of shared keys shows identical nonce chains and a second slash bans the address class for 6 epochs.
